label: step right after an early g (positions 2-4)
explanation: Sparse feature that fires almost only on the step immediately after the token g was input, when g sits at original position 2-4 (t=3..5). That step is either the next original token or <DEL>. 87.5% of activation mass has prev_tok==g. It never fires in the copy phase or at t<2. Precision is very low (~3%): most steps right after an early g do not activate it. Context makes it more likely: an earlier j in the prefix (first_tok j has 7x lift), other early letters such as h/i/f/v, or a repeated g (g g) all help. The current input also matters: g, s, l or <DEL> raise the rate. The top activations are sequences like j j j g g s, h j g g <DEL>, j g g s. None of these refinements gave a clean rule (best F1 ~0.2), so the gating context looks graded rather than boolean.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=g (+7.26), orig0=j (+4.11), prev2_tok=g (+4.00), orig0=h (+2.99), orig0=f (+2.97), prev2_tok=e (+2.89). Lower it: phase=2 (-4.81), prev3_tok=d (-2.53), in_tok=0 (-2.44), orig1=a (-2.32).
